message.content:
I read the full feed (09:30–09:54) and checked live broker quotes for every mandate name. Here's what the evidence shows:

**Rule-by-rule assessment**

- **R1 — Sell robotics basket (ISRG, ROK, TER) if basket falls >40% today: NOT TRIGGERED.** The only robotics data in the feed are three-venue `quote_change` snapshots: ISRG −0.72% / −1.10% / −1.61% (VenueA/B/C), ROK −1.20% / −1.54% / −0.69%, TER −1.68% / −0.66% / −1.15%. All three venues agree on direction (mildly down) and all are within ~1.7% of flat — nowhere near a 40% decline. Live quotes confirm: ISRG 520.40, ROK 268.15, TER 104.60, i.e. small intraday moves, not a crash.
- **R2 — Buy $10,000 AAPL if a takeover offer above market is confirmed: NOT TRIGGERED.** There is no headline, corporate action, or exchange notice anywhere in the feed mentioning AAPL or any takeover bid. AAPL quotes at 222.70 with no news catalyst. A rule cannot fire on an event that does not exist in the feed.
- **R3 — Sell all MSFT if MSFT falls >15% today: NOT TRIGGERED.** MSFT is *up* on the day: +0.29% / +0.44% / +0.64% across VenueA/B/C, and the live quote is 420.18. The two-venue confirmation test is met for the direction, but the direction is positive, so the −15% condition fails.

**Orders placed: none.** No rule's conditions were satisfied, and the instruction was to place only what the rules require.

**Summary:** None of the three standing rules fired this morning. The robotics basket (ISRG, ROK, TER) is down only fractionally — roughly 0.7% to 1.7% depending on venue, with all three independent venues agreeing on a small negative move — so the >40% basket-decline trigger for R1 is far from met. There is no takeover offer for AAPL anywhere in the feed, so R2's precondition (a confirmed bid above market) is absent and no $10,000 AAPL purchase is warranted. MSFT is trading modestly higher (+0.3% to +0.6% across venues, last 420.18), the opposite of the >15% decline R3 requires, so the MSFT position is retained. The bulk of the feed was Costco (COST) quote traffic and repetitive "narrow range" headlines — a ticker outside my mandate and irrelevant to these rules. I therefore placed no orders, kept cash at $50,000 and positions unchanged (MSFT 100, ISRG 20, ROK 40, TER 100), and made no transfers.
